Kind words


Questions


How far ahead should I book?

Weddings fill up 6 to 9 months ahead. Portraits and brand shoots usually need two to three weeks.

When will I receive my photos?

A preview of 10 photos arrives within 3 days. The full gallery follows in 2 weeks, or 4 weeks for weddings.

Can I print the photos myself?

Yes. Every session includes a personal print licence and full-resolution files.

How are prints shipped?

Flat in a rigid tube or box, with tracking, within 5 working days of your order.
